title: Minutes that build shared creative understanding, not governance (2026-11-27)

sections.name: narrative
sections.label: Narrative
sections.content:
These minutes are not about governance. They are about building shared creative understanding of a project. We want to capture and communicate the big picture, and the activity, and potential tasks and ways to be involved.

This is about creating the layers of understanding for a community that will allow for different people to take part. I tend to lead all these, and my voice is the strongest, but Sam holds all the technical infrastructure work and bar management, so we have a good team. Michael does the promotion, and our DJ's work well with us.

Lets see if we can create a process and a protocol that will create me a version of the minutes from each meeting and then build up the common overview document. We may need a set of different protocols here, and the output might need to actually be it's own website.
